positions.name: MissingIdHandling
positions.frame: what should the system do when a markdown heading carries no id field?
positions.why: src-1 reproduces the production failure pattern — a ## heading with no id field — and src-2 states the directive that the system must not crash and must produce a valid slug. Together they cohere under the question of how the derive-id pipeline should handle the missing-id case: the failure pattern is the input, the no-crash/valid-slug requirement is the expected behavior.
